serviceName: Foral — DKIM signing keys and DMARC policy
description: Adds the DKIM CNAMEs generated by our outbound provider (AhaSend) so that messages sent from the domain are signed, plus the DMARC policy that tells receivers what to do when a message fails to align. DMARC travels with the keys deliberately: publishing a policy before anything signs asks receivers to distrust the domain's own legitimate mail. Applied after the `verify-mx` template has run and ownership has been confirmed — the DKIM values vary per account because each one has unique selectors.
